result.instructions: Tools for ShippingEasy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the orders that are ready for shipment in my store."; "Which orders changed in the last 24 hours, and what is their status?"; "Mark order 10234 as awaiting shipment.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ShippingEasy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shippingeasy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shippingeasy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shippingeasy_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. shippingeasy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shippingeasy_list_stores
tools.title: List stores
tools.description: List all stores of this ShippingEasy account, with the store API key of each store. Use a store API key in the store tools. Uses GET /api/stores.

tools.name: shippingeasy_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search orders across all stores of this account. Filter by last update time, status, order number or tag. Uses GET /api/orders.

last_updated_at.description: Only orders updated at or after this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2026-10-25T00:00:00.000-00:00. Default one week ago; at most 3 months ago.

status.description: Only orders with this ShippingEasy status.

includes.description: Use products to add product details to each order.

order_number.description: The external order identifier (the e-commerce order number) to find.

tools.name: shippingeasy_search_store_orders
tools.title: Search store orders
tools.description: Search orders of one store, by its store API key. Same filters as shippingeasy_search_orders. Uses GET /api/stores/{store_api_key}/orders.

store_api_key.description: The store API key, from shippingeasy_list_stores (Settings > Stores & Orders).

last_updated_at.description: Only orders updated at or after this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2026-10-25T00:00:00.000-00:00. Default one week ago; at most 3 months ago.

status.description: Only orders with this ShippingEasy status.

includes.description: Use products to add product details to each order.

order_number.description: The external order identifier (the e-commerce order number) to find.

tools.name: shippingeasy_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by its ShippingEasy order id, with its recipients and line items. Uses GET /api/orders/{id}.

order_id.description: The ShippingEasy order id (the id field in order results).

tools.name: shippingeasy_update_order_status
tools.title: Update order status
tools.description: Set the store order status of one order, by its external order identifier. Sets the Status shown in ShippingEasy. Uses PUT /api/stores/{store_api_key}/orders/{external_order_identifier}/status.

store_api_key.description: The store API key, from shippingeasy_list_stores (Settings > Stores & Orders).

external_order_identifier.description: The e-commerce order number of the order (external_order_identifier).

tools.name: shippingeasy_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel an order
tools.description: Cancel an order in ShippingEasy, so it is not shipped from there. Use it when the order was shipped or cancelled outside ShippingEasy. Uses POST /api/stores/{store_api_key}/orders/{order_id}/cancellations.

store_api_key.description: The store API key, from shippingeasy_list_stores (Settings > Stores & Orders).

order_id.description: The ShippingEasy order id (the id field in order results).
